description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Merrick & Company is hiring an entry-level Civil Infrastructure Engineer to support its Civil Infrastructure and Development team. The role contributes to land development and municipal infrastructure projects through design, construction documentation, estimating, bid review, and coordination with clients and government agencies.
Civil Infrastructure Engineer I designing land development and municipal infrastructure, preparing drawings, estimates, and bid packages

Responsibilities:
• Perform independent design tasks, prepare construction drawings, organize reports, calculations, and associated project deliverables
• Work within a team of Design Engineers and technicians on Land Development and municipal infrastructure projects
• Prepare and review working drawings, details, layouts, surveys, estimates, and work products
• Exercise initiative, judgment, and knowledge as required in areas of responsibility
• Perform cost estimates, prepare bid packages, review contractor bids
• Interface with clients, and Local, State, and Federal government agencies

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Sciences in Civil Engineering from an ABET Accredited Program
• Zero (0) – Two (2) years of experience in Land Development and/or Public Works
• Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship

Preferred:
• Fundamentals of Engineering / Engineer- in-Training (EIT) certification
• Recent demonstrable experience in AutoCAD Civil 3D
• Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, etc.)
